places-central-balkan-steneto-reserve-ce.story: From Karlovo it runs 100 km to Karlovo; allow about 1 h 43 of riding. On the way it passes Central Balkan - Kozya stena Reserve, Central Balkan - Boatin Reserve and back through Central Balkan - Kozya stena Reserve. The highest point is about 1,050 m. The line favours views over speed.
